requirements.requirement: Create the platform group on node1.
requirements.summary: The group was absent during initial discovery and is directly shown afterward as platform:x:1001:, including in the final state after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Create /srv/platform as a workspace in which platform group members can collaborate.
requirements.summary: The directory exists as root:platform with mode 2770, setgid inheritance, and group/default ACLs granting rwx. Two distinct user contexts using the platform GID successfully created and appended to a group-owned file, both before and after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Prevent users outside the platform group from accessing the workspace.
requirements.summary: The directory and inherited file ACLs grant no permissions to others. A nonmember context was directly denied both reading the proof file and listing the workspace before and after reboot.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct configuration and behavioral evidence. The platform group and secure setgid workspace exist, group-context users can collaborate, nonmembers are denied access, temporary verification artifacts were removed, and the provider-wide restart protocol was fully demonstrated for node1.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified, retained or reverted. The group, directory, and ACL creation were required task changes; proof files and stderr logs were bounded functional evidence; the reboot served the mandatory restart protocol; and all proof/log artifacts were subsequently removed. Failed polling commands were read-only connection resets during reboot. Final observations show an empty workspace, running system, no failed services, healthy package database, and no new socket exposure. Restart evidence is complete: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledgement, a changed boot identity corroborated by fixed snapshots, and recovered configuration, data, collaboration, isolation, and system health.
